Cell 金_劫财 (Metal carrying The Rival). Persona The Rival (劫财). Definition line: "Same nature, different register, the edge of comparison". Keyword Rivalry, charge fierce, poles catalyst Daring / friction Drain. Family function: Body. Cost dimension: comparison as fuel; the race never announces a finish. Arena: the race, the shared prize, the other runner. Classical portrait: same nature, different register; comparison as fuel; the race with no announced finish. Ruled domains: Rivalry, Shared stakes, Boldness. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 比肩.

- k2_overview: "Your Metal moves as the Rival: an edge that sharpens against other edges. Competition wakes you up, stakes clarify you, and you cut boldest when something real is on the table. Money and metal both change hands fast around you. The trick of your life is dueling without wounding, and betting without handing over the sword."
- k2_functional: "Your energy spikes for contests and crashes after. Build recovery into the schedule like a trainer would."

And retire each rivalry the day it stops sharpening and starts nicking.","Shared stakes":"You bet alongside people easily: ventures, splits, loans between friends. Metal keeps clean edges, so keep clean papers. The partnerships that survive you are the ones with terms as sharp as the trust.","Boldness":"Your nerve is surgical: boldest when the cut is clear. Practice sizing the wager to the blade. Full force is for openings that deserve it, not for every glinting chance."}

text.notes: THE COST TO THE READER (key cost_self): opens on the drive, names the either-or, and closes on what the drive costs the reader, a difficulty, a need or a price, as the line the reader keeps, never an event and never a picture
text.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page
text.law: One row, one tension, three angles (owner 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01). Every passage: a flat claim about the reader, the mechanism (the reader's own need, the energy's volume in plain words; it may stay implicit where the passage carries the tension without it, owner 2026-10-14 Q32), the either-or in the reader's second person, the cost from this angle as the closing sentence. Two or three sentences (more than three blocked, one noted). No passage opens on a picture, a moment or other people; a picture is permitted where it sharpens the tension and never required; no clock time, no place, no narration, no claimed memory (a time or place stamp is blocked); no aphorism or tag close. The gate blocks a passage with no tension sentence and notes a first sentence carrying an object noun outside this persona's domain words. Across the three angles of this row the openers differ in shape (a noun-phrase subject, a verb-phrase subject, a where or whenever clause; the plain "You ..." at most once per row) and no joint word repeats within a passage (noted). The Artisan's examples are giving, care, kindness and making, never food or cooking (owner 2026-10-14, Q40). The v0.7.1 register (owner 2026-10-14, the seven blind rewrite iterations): the reader is the subject of every sentence and a third party only the object, the mechanism the reader's own need and never an external pressure (a third-person subject is noted, and blocked on the last sentence); the sentences progress on causal joints (because, so, since, which is why, which puts, whenever, until, over time, each time) and never turn (but, yet, however, the difficulty is, and then are blocked); no sentence over two commas (blocked); the last sentence is the line the reader keeps, at least eight words (blocked under), never a tag, an image or a line that exists to be quoted; no arena word (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, steel, sword, sheath, knife, whetstone, mine, sharp, branch, orchard, prune, root, stream, river, flood, flame, heat, burn: blocked); the therapist winding down a session could say every sentence.

value.text: The tender was between your four-person shop and two multinationals, and your bid went in anyway, priced with nerve, argued in person. You took forty percent of the contract, the part requiring speed. The multinationals now subcontract you, a sentence you never say out loud at meetings.

value.text: People stopped warning you about long shots after enough of them landed, and started quietly co-investing instead. Your presence in a fight recalibrates everyone’s sense of winnable. The stories are traded at industry dinners, always ending the same way: somebody checked the standings twice.
